body:
# Never Let Your Tools, Armor, or Weapons Break Again!
**ItWillBreak** is a simple and user-friendly plugin to alert you in case your item is about to break.


# Supported items

ItWillBreak supports all kind of items such as Tools, Armor, Bows, Shield and much more ! 

# Languages

**ItWillBreak** supports almost all languages, such as **English**, **Spanish**, **French**, **German**, **Italian**, and expanding support for more languages is really easy. 

# How to use it ? 

Simply add the plugin to your server's plugin folder. It supports **Paper**, **Pufferfish**, **Pupur** and even **Folia**, from **1.21.4** all the way to the **latest** version.
